summary: Two quotient banks expose a prompt-blind fraction-bar shortcut. It succeeds on 13/13 fresh tests and affects 1/5 actual batch records after delivery filtering. Math, native grading, rendering, and package integrity passed. No affected generated inventory instance was demonstrated at captured basis 5365.

source_analysis.skill: Factor a first-order separable differential equation as h(x)g(y), then multiply the derivative by 1/g(y) so its multiplier depends only on y and the right side only on x.
reasoning_steps: Recognize products, quotients, exponent-sum identities, or a single common factor in the supplied RHS.
Take the reciprocal of g(y) and retain h(x); distinguish an equivalent but unseparated rearrangement from a separated equation.
Select the single appropriate equation from five mathematical radio choices; do not integrate.
invariants: First derivative dy/dx and the separated convention (1/g(y)) dy/dx=h(x), per tutorial 6767.
Same algebraic separation workload and five-choice response contract; no integration or initial conditions.
Unique correct equation must both follow from the original equation and meet the separated convention.
Respect domains of radicals and divisors, including local exclusion g(y)=0.
permitted_variations: Nonzero scalar coefficients, modest powers, exponential bases/slopes, and rational shifts in the supported simple factors.
Move eligible dependent factors between numerator and denominator; this changes reciprocal versus direct multiplier and is not fixed by the skill.
Vary signs/slopes in exponent-splitting families while preserving the same exponent law.
Vary which displayed choice position is correct, and eligible distractor roles; a fixed correct position is incidental.
Vary the x-only factor independently of the y-only factor, deriving prompt, key, and explanation together.
source_refs: tutorial 6767 / 56fc1c96-3599-5022-8d83-60d4188ccf07: separable iff dy/dx=h(x)g(y); separated iff (1/g(y))dy/dx=h(x); requires g(y)!=0.
tutorial 6766 / dfb65111-b319-54c6-84cc-f60506595a69: e^(x-y)=e^x/e^y, then e^y dy/dx=e^x.

source_replay.details: All ten captured five-choice source banks reproduce prompts, complete banks, keys, and solutions after harmless whitespace/left-right normalization. Canonical radical is lesson-only with no captured answer bank; it is explicitly recorded as unsupported rather than claimed as a replay.

math.details: Independent displayed-equation parsing verified unique separated equivalence and every solution stage for 51 source/boundary/fresh/batch/counterfactual records. All passed.

variety.details: All six easy templates and both direct/reciprocal transfers survive filtering, but exp_quotient and simple_quotient preserve a uniquely fractionless correct row across their entire parameterized bank recipes. Parameter and text variety do not defeat that conditional shortcut.

scope.details: Supported easy and moderate families retain the source algebraic separation task and radio response. Authored hard is labeled as an extension using independent-factor recovery; no integration or new calculus operation is introduced. Canonical radical replay limitation is disclosed.

grading.details: Actual native grade_field checked every option on 64 complete records: 64 accepted and 256 rejected. Includes equivalent-but-unseparated distractors, controlled pairs, and shortcut selections. All fields are radio, so free-entry equivalent notation is inapplicable.

rendering.details: Unmodified UI rendered 19 records, including all five batch members and all controlled pairs. Reports pass; inspected screenshots show readable notation, controls, and full worked solutions. The fraction-bar shortcut is visually present.

packaging.details: Exact installed Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0 match manifest. Declared files exist; deterministic replay and relocation pass; invalid bounds/types/fields/difficulty are rejected. Package content hashes unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant controlled pairs update/preserve prompt, solution, answer, native outcomes and rendered content correctly. Nevertheless, selecting the sole row without a fraction outside dy/dx bypasses separation in both quotient families: 13/13 fresh, 5/5 accepted control quotient records, and 1/1 actual batch quotient record. Captured generated inventory has no demonstrated instance; two original sources share the cue and are not mislabeled as generated.

findings.description: In exp_quotient and simple_quotient, the correct response is always the sole choice without a fraction outside dy/dx. A learner can hide the ODE and select that row. This is a visual bank invariant, not reciprocal-factor reasoning. It survives both generator/UI shuffling and publication filtering. Actual batch question 7412ba17-9fc5-51fc-b2a5-80c01769de08 is affected; this is one defective batch member, not a claim that this cue answers all five.

Correct y*dy/dx=x is the only row without another fraction. Complete record: minimal-failing-record.json. Batch case: seed=2404317989, exp_quotient, base=4,a=3,n=4; choose y^4*dy/dx=4^(3x). Native grader confirms acceptance in grader-complete-report.json; actual UI screenshot render-all/question-003.png confirms the cue.
findings.requested_change: Change normal-generation bank construction for both quotient families so fractionless layout cannot uniquely designate the correct equation. Include plausible same-scope incorrect fractionless equations and vary eligible distractor roles, requiring comparison with the ODE. Preserve observed banks for source replay, retain both families, and add the retained prompt-blind selection probe as a failing regression until the cue is broken. Replace the affected batch member with an independently validated revised-bank record; option shuffling or numerical changes alone do not repair this rule.
